ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: activeCall is not defined — thrown on mount, blanks the entire /admin page. The JSX at line 202 references `activeCall`/`setActiveCall`, line 200 references `callCandidate`, line 189 & 199 reference `chatFocus`/`setChatFocus`; none of these are declared as useState/function in the AdminDashboard() body (only defined in inner sub-components Applications/Interviews/Meetings). Every Phase E flow (nav-meeting, nav-recordings, candidate-profile-dialog opening, profile-*-btn actions, activeCall VideoCall render) is unreachable because the whole dashboard fails to render.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.js AdminDashboard() top (near line 96), add missing state + handler: `const [activeCall, setActiveCall] = useState(null); const [chatFocus, setChatFocus] = useState(null); const callCandidate = async (user_id, name, mode) => { try { const { data } = await api.post('/calls', { callee_id: user_id, mode: mode==='audio' ? 'audio' : 'video' }); setActiveCall({ room: data.room, audioOnly: mode==='audio', recordCtx: { title: `Entretien — ${name||''}`.trim(), candidate_id: user_id, candidate_name: name } }); } catch (e) { toast.error(e?.response?.data?.detail || 'Impossible de démarrer l\u2019appel'); } };`

After the fix, retest UI: nav-meeting → start-meeting-btn → video-call-modal + copy-invite-link; nav-recordings → no-recordings or recording-<id> card; open candidate profile from Utilisateurs → candidate-profile-dialog → profile-chat-btn / profile-audio-btn / profile-video-btn.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.js still ~1242 lines; the missing-symbol crash would have been caught by an ESLint no-undef rule — recommend enabling it in CI.

process_recording() in server.py always uses videoBytes when audio absent — fine as fallback, but Whisper expects audio codec; a webm-video-only blob may make transcription fail silently (returns '') which is acceptable per spec, but consider logging that path.

GET /api/calls/incoming uses a 45s ringing cutoff based on created_at — if network jitter delays candidate poll, ringing modal may miss short calls; consider raising to 60s or checking status transitions instead of time.
No auth check on GET /api/calls/{id} (any authenticated user can read any call by id). Low risk since id is a uuid, but consider restricting to caller_id/callee_id.
Iter_9 comments about file size (>700 lines) and rating-* testid namespace overlap still stand.
